"''He'll be here.|This clone trooper and Captain Rex, during the Battle of Teth|}} This clone trooper, a member of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], which was part of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], participated in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|This is it! Scrap 'em!|Captain Rex to the clone trooper|}} In 22 BBY, after the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], along with Torrent Company, went to the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] to rescue [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] son, who was being held captive in the [[B'omarr Monastery]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On the way to the monastery, their gunships were fired upon by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], but they managed to land near the base of the mountain atop which it was located without any casualties. General Skywalker, Commander Tano, Captain [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and the other members of Torrent Company fought against the droids while scaling the ridge of the mountain. They managed to secure the temple and locate the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]], but [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces attacked them again, forcing the remaining troops back inside the temple. The two Jedi, along with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], took Rotta to search for an escape route, while the clones remained at the main entrance to delay the droids. After Separatist forces led by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] breached the temple, the surviving members of Torrent Company, including this trooper, were taken prisoner. When Skywalker attempted to contact Rex through his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a pair of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 battle droids]] who were guarding the prisoners attempted to investigate the source of the sound. When one of them leaned in for a closer look, Rex told the droid that he would show it "how it works" before punching it and taking its blaster. The othet clones followed suit and, Rex and this clone trooper began taking cover behind the leg joint of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walker]]. The trooper warned the captain that they couldn't hold out much longer, and asked where General Skywalker was. The captain reassured the trooper that he would be there. Later on, the trooper destroyed a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droid]] by shooting out its head and arm joints. Rex called for a last stand, telling his men to 'scrap' the other droids before both jumped from the AT-TE. Eventually, the two clones became surrounded by battle droids. One of the droids told the clones to surrender, to which the captain replied that the droids were outnumbered. The droid began counting its allies before Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], flying his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]], destroyed them. The battle continued as Commander [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] arrived, along with members of the [[7th Sky Corps/Legends|7th Sky Corps]], and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was eventually able to successfully extract the surviving members of Torrent Company. ==Personality and traits== The clone trooper was observant, understanding that, being outnumbered by the battle droids, his unit would be defeated without help. He was shown to be intelligent and to have excellent tactical knowledge, shooting a vulture droid in its leg so it would fall. ==Equipment== The clone trooper wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] in combat and, after being taken prisoner by the droids and attacking them along with the rest of his company, used an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]] taken from a droid. ==Behind the scenes== ===Inconsistencies=== The clone trooper first appeared in the [[2008]] film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']]. He, like all clone troopers in the film, was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the film, Rex, [[Coric]], [[Zeer]], [[Attie]], [[Nax]], and [[Del]] were the only surviving members of Torrent Company by the end of the Battle of Teth.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] This clone trooper did not appear in the novel and, while it is possible that he was one of the survivors mentioned in it, he was not identified as being one of the survivors. Therefore, it is possible that he was killed at some point during the battle. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Members of the 501st Legion (Galactic Republic)]] [[Category:Members of Torrent Company]]
